eps.t: All the Things We're Never Going to Have

eps.t: A New Starting Point for Further Desires
eps.o: While Josh tries to play off Ashley's ascendance at the club, Lindsay seeks petty revenge. The Chairwoman proposes changes at the gym.

eps.t: Oh, the Comfort, the Inexpressible Comfort
eps.o: When Austin and Ashley are trapped for hours in an ER waiting room, Josh sees an opportunity to turn the tables.

eps.t: I Am Killing My Flesh Without It
eps.o: Lindsay and Josh's marital strife comes to a head when an unexpected crisis hits home.
Josh and Austin try to mend fences with a training session. Lindsay tutors Ashley in the delicate art of winning over the club's wives.
Ashley, Lindsay and Ava's girls' getaway to Seoul is upended by old tensions, new revelations and shocking confessions at 30,000 feet.

eps.t: It Will Stay This Way and You Will Obey
eps.o: Fighting for survival on the Chairwoman's home turf, both couples must decide what — and for whom — they're willing to sacrifice.
